subject.title: fix(agents): classify Anthropic invalid_request_error as format for failover

question: After the schema-diagnostic regression is fixed, should every structured `invalid_request_error` follow the existing 400/422 `format` fallback behavior, including deterministic request and configuration errors?
rationale: The mapping is consistent with the existing HTTP-status classifier and fixes a real broken fallback path, but it intentionally changes routing for a broad provider error category and may send deterministic failures to another model or provider.

options.title: Keep broad parity
options.body: Preserve the PR’s all-`invalid_request_error` fallback behavior after restoring schema diagnostics, matching the existing 400/422 status path.

options.title: Narrow eligible errors
options.body: Limit fallback to known replay, thinking-block, or provider-compatibility signatures and leave other deterministic invalid requests terminal.

recommendation.title: Keep broad parity
recommendation.body: Preserve the PR’s all-`invalid_request_error` fallback behavior after restoring schema diagnostics, matching the existing 400/422 status path.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and stabilized the runtime failure taxonomy whose semantics this PR changes.
